Findings: Unix in/out initially create both handshake pipes then close disabled parent descriptors;Windows substitutes NUL child handles for disabled directions. Inheriting the host console is not equivalent.
stderr_to_stdout assigns child stderr to the same OS stdout descriptor/handle;two managed reader tasks cannot preserve original inter-stream order.
arg0 is child argv[0],independent from executable lookup;Windows CreateProcess needs application name separated from command line.
nouse_stdio requires child descriptors3/4;ProcessStartInfo alone cannot assign arbitrary descriptors.
overlapped_io is a Windows transport setting with real native pipe flags;not an ordinary data-format option.
Next: Implement a typed owned native spawn transport for descriptor/handle setup and custom argv0,then independently verify options and cleanup;do not silently accept unsupported settings.
